assessment: This manuscript provides a comprehensive analysis of expression patterns and genomic features of long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) in the human developing gonad. Using multiple genetic and molecular biology strategies in an in vitro system of female germ cell differentiation, the study further provides compelling evidence of a positive regulatory function of the LNC1845 lncRNA on its protein-coding neighbor LHX8, known to have a role in ovarian follicle development. This study has important interest to reproductive biologists and to the non-coding RNA community.
